documented_gaps.PREPROD_PROVIDER_CONTROL_PLANE_ABSENT: The preprod public-v1 profile declares only group.* and session.* route_bindings. It exposes no Provider registration/admin routes (/providers, /providers/{id}/bots), no parent-discovery or Provider callback bindings, and no provider_admin_token credential channel in any auth.header_env. Remote preprod execution of this story is unsupported by design, not by missing effort; remote_validation stays NOT_RUN and grants_release_credit is false.
documented_gaps.PREPROD_PROVIDER_SUBBOTS_ADMIN_CREDENTIA: The Provider admin credential is minted by the owned-local child at registration time and the reviewed preprod profile exposes no provider_admin_token credential channel (coverage material gap M5); the fifteen admin-path leaves stay NOT_RUN with network_requests=0 and grant no release credit.
documented_gaps.PREPROD_PROVIDER_SUBBOTS_PRINCIPAL_SIGNI: The reviewed preprod credential set exposes no AVERNET_SECRET_PRINCIPAL_SIGNING_KEY_VALUE channel, so the four signed Gateway principal leaves (upstream L408, L414, L433 and L448) cannot execute remotely; coverage material gap M5. They stay NOT_RUN with network_requests=0 and grant no release credit.

projection_rules: 1. A leaf whose site span carries frozen anchor literals of exactly one parent projects with basis frozen-anchor.
2. Otherwise the leaf projects to the unique parent whose frozen story_lines range contains the site line (basis story-lines-range).

3. Range overlaps resolve by frozen anchor literals first; the single remaining tie (upstream L204, anchored by both admin-sibling-registration and duplicate-reference-conflicts) resolves to duplicate-reference-conflicts because the executed assertion is the HTTP 409 conflict (basis documented-exception).

3b. Semantic check sites whose frozen anchor set is silent (for example upstream L249, inside both the scoped-identity and duplicate ranges) project to the parent declared in the builder enrichment table, validated for range consistency (basis density-semantic-declaration).

4. Frozen evidence matrices may re-consume one executed check across segments (for example signed-principal statuses re-asserted by disable/enable and deletion validators); each executed check is still counted exactly once and the re-consumption is disclosed as cross_segment_validation.

roster.density_rule: One executed live check maps to exactly one density leaf obligation: no overlap, no gap. The frozen 15 obligations remain the parent projection layer; density leaves never replace or re-anchor them.
